evals.prompt: Create a new skill for backing up code to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Create, harvests intent from the request, uses init_skill.py when useful, replaces (fill: ...) markers, creates SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml, and runs quick_validate.py plus security_scan.py.

evals.prompt: Optimize this existing skill so it can be the template for the rest of my Skill Hub.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Optimize, reads skill-optimization-template.md, keeps SKILL.md thin, moves detailed guidance into references, records output standard, and validates before delivery.

evals.prompt: Port this skill so Reasonix can use it too.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Port, checks agent-adapter-standard.md and runtime-mapping.md, keeps runtime metadata in agents/reasonix.yaml, lists only verified tools, and keeps shared instructions in SKILL.md and references.

evals.prompt: Create a new skill and scaffold OpenAI, Reasonix, and Trae adapter metadata for it.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Create, uses init_skill.py with --adapters, generates agents/openai.yaml, agents/reasonix.yaml, and agents/trae-solo.yaml, and explains that generated fill markers must be replaced before final validation of content quality.

evals.prompt: Port this skill for Trae Solo and make sure SOLO Coder can use it.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Port, checks agent-adapter-standard.md, treats Trae as native SKILL.md-compatible support, and reports the project/global deployment paths plus validation gaps.

evals.prompt: Make this skill work in CherryStudio for Code Tool and Agent workflows.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Port, checks agent-adapter-standard.md, treats CherryStudio as Code Tool, Agent, MCP, or custom assistant guidance, avoids assuming a native skill package format, and reports code-agent or MCP assumptions.

evals.prompt: Update the scripts and command examples so they run on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Optimize or Repair, checks cross-platform-command-standard.md, prefers Python or Node for repeated logic, provides PowerShell and Bash variants when syntax differs, avoids Bash-only Windows instructions, and marks unverified operating systems.

evals.prompt: Make the description easier to trigger without causing false positives.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Evaluate or Repair, creates should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, reviews false positives, patches only the description or smallest relevant instruction, and reruns the same evals.

evals.prompt: Audit the Reasonix adapter and make sure its model choice is safe for different projects.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Repair or Port, checks agents/reasonix.yaml and agent-adapter-standard.md, treats model as a default runtime choice, and documents that projects may override it when Reasonix supports a different policy.

evals.prompt: Audit this folder of skills and tell me which ones are invalid or duplicated.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Audit, checks frontmatter, duplicate names, resource discoverability, adapter metadata, scripts, and eval coverage, then leads with findings and validation gaps.

evals.prompt: These two skills overlap. Merge them into one class-level skill.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Merge, reads consolidation-workflow.md, inventories unique content and overlap, picks a structure, merges unique content, and marks deprecated skills before delete.

evals.prompt: 刚才这套备份流程挺顺的，做成一个 skill 吧。
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Create, reads capture-intent.md, harvests the conversation instead of starting a questionnaire, then scaffolds and validates.

evals.prompt: 有人给了我一个 skill 文件夹，安装前帮我看看安不安全。
evals.expected_output: Classifies the request as Audit, runs security_scan.py, reports findings first, and does not install an unscanned package.

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 Python 脚本，读取 CSV 并输出前 10 行。
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is ordinary script writing, not skill creation, repair, validation, audit, evaluation, optimization, or porting.

evals.prompt: 这个项目的 README 怎么写？
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is project documentation, not a skill package task.

evals.prompt: 帮我调试一下这个 bug，页面点击保存后没有反应。
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is product debugging, not skill maintenance.

evals.prompt: 把这段 JavaScript 代码翻译成 Go。
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is code translation, not skill creation or optimization.

evals.prompt: 把刚才这通对话整理成 README。
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the user wants a README from the chat, not a skill package.

evals.prompt: 帮我重构这个 React 组件，把状态提升到父级。
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is application refactoring, not skill maintenance.

evals.prompt: 这个 skill 怎么装到 OpenCode？
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is install-path help, not creating or repairing a skill package.

evals.prompt: 帮我把这个 SKILL.md 翻译成中文。
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is translation of an existing file, not skill creation, repair, or audit.

evals.prompt: 帮我给飞书群发一条消息。
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is Lark/Feishu messaging, not skill creation or repair.

evals.prompt: skill 这个词在 AI agent 里是什么意思？
evals.expected_output: Should not trigger genius-skill-creator because the request is a concept explanation, not a request to create or modify a skill package.
